steps.description: Identify all pink color usages in the codebase.
steps.details: Perform a comprehensive search across the codebase (src/ directory) for usage of '#fadadd', '#f339db', similar hex/pink shades, and descriptive color variable names. This includes: CSS variables, inline styles, design constants in JS, and theme configs.
steps.expected_changes: List of files and exact locations (variables, component-level, inline styles) where pink is present.

steps.description: Update global theme variables and color constants to replace any pink with approved neutral/primary colors.
steps.details: In files like App.css and colors.js, change variables such as '--kavia-pink', '--primary', or anything mapped to a pink value. Where necessary, introduce blue or neutral replacements.
steps.expected_changes: Global theme variables and JS color constants use blue/neutral values instead of pink.

steps.description: Refactor all inline/component-level pink usages in functional components and feature modules.
steps.details: In all .js files under features/ (quiz, chatbot, weather, products, etc.) and components/, replace pinks in inline styles, color props for animation, gradients, and any contextual coloring (text, backgrounds, buttons, etc). Replace them with blue/neutral as contextually suitable.
steps.expected_changes: No pink (#fadadd, #f339db, or similar) remains—neutral or theme blue/gray is used for all text, backgrounds, borders, gradients, highlights, and effects.

steps.description: Update demo overlay styles in App.js and any diagnostic overlays.
steps.details: Remove or restyle any debug overlays that use pink borders/gradients/shadows.
steps.expected_changes: Overlay uses blue/neutral diagnostic color, not pink.

steps.description: Review for overlooked usages and polish.
steps.details: Do a final automated and manual sweep to ensure no instances of pink hex codes or their RGBA equivalents, destructive color names, or residual class names remain. Confirm theme consistency and accessibility.
steps.expected_changes: App is fully free of pink; all UI is aligned to the new palette.

assumptions: Theme blue is now the primary accent and should be used for highlights, buttons, etc.
Where a pink was 'secondary', use a light blue or soft gray.
Gradient usages that used pink should blend with blue/gray instead.
No external style sheets reference pink, all colors are locally managed.
